args.title: Fix the first run of weekly scheduled exports
args.body:
File: src/export/scheduler.ts

The weekly scheduled exports are not sent on the first run due to the timing of the report creation. This change addresses the issue to ensure that the first weekly scheduled export is sent correctly.
